messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] setting intervals in data filter or diagnostics when working with radial distances
parts:
Urvi

I'm assuming your question relates to analysis of point transect data, where radial distances are recorded and that's how I will answer.  Line transect data can also be collected using radial distance and bearing, but I'll not address that.

There is no need to bin data by setting cutpoints for binning data with point transect data.  Using exact distance measures will work just fine.  When creating bins for fitting detection functions, the shape of the detection function will depend upon the choice of cutpoints used for binning.  Cutpoint choice is largely subjective. Under normal circumstances, you would avoid subjective decisions in analysis, as subjectivity lessens the likelihood that analyses are repeatable.
